extraction.notes: No items. The Labor rights section (pages 16-21) contains no material on foreign workers, employment of foreigners, worker mobility between countries or social security across borders; a search of the whole text for foreign, migrant, permit, emigration, Open Balkan, seasonal and residence found none in this section. The section covers cost of living and poverty, wages and trade union protests, the drafting of a new Law on Labor Relations (definition of employee, non-discrimination, equal pay, self-employment), the 2023 amendments for the Bechtel and Enka motorway project and the Helsinki Committee's constitutional initiative, free legal aid, State Labor Inspectorate supervision and the length of labour disputes. This is labour law and social policy (Chapter 19), outside Chapter 2, so not extracted. Technology mentions are incidental: publication of the draft law on the Unified National Electronic Register of Regulations (page 19) and salaries 'published on the web' as a transparency example (page 18). The register note for this source ('Labour rights section on foreign workers') does not match the content. The report's Digital rights and freedoms section (page 42) was not read, as instructed.
